name: designing union change
from: A named requirement and a contradiction set with no architecture or high-level design yet standing between them and an implementation.
to: A candidate SoftwareArchitectureSpecificationK and HighLevelDesignK, purchased from a high-reasoning provider and linked to the requirement and the evidence that grounds them.
cost: Provider purchase cost on the inference-work-lot market at the high reasoning class, plus the offices attention reviewing what the provider returns before treating it as a candidate rather than a decision.
otherwise: Decomposition and actuation proceed against no architecture at all, and the shape of the change is discovered by the mutation itself rather than decided before it.
